question: Does training on matched opposing human hypotheses transfer to the remaining independent human-edited BoolQ questions when the recurrent layer starts from the quantized instruction sibling?
gate: At least five net wholly correct human-edited passage pairs, paired exact two-sided p<=.05, at least three additional correct shared-prefix decisions, and no more total generation time than untouched Base. No retuning on this or earlier contrast panel. A win licenses equal-training single-pass and an independent ordinary BoolQ validation comparison. Failure closes this checkpoint.
protocol: Repeat native last attention layer twice with 0.35 gated residual and rank-32 LoRA. Mix four BoolQ training passages and two same-premise e-SNLI entailed/contradicted pairs per minibatch. Fit the entire response with free-vocabulary cross entropy and add .35 times softplus(1 - (affirmative log-odds for supported claim minus contradicted claim)). Both scores use an identical closed-thinking answer prefix with no gold explanation. 2048 independent BoolQ training passages and 512 human-labeled SNLI training pairs. Freeze the 32 eligible Gardner passages outside the first human study. Both arms see complete passages, thinking prompt, same greedy policy, new item order, 384-token cap and scorer. This jointly tests a new initialization, training corpus and loss. The Base-initialized failed single-question fit is closed.
